discovery.title: The right tool for your next adventure.
discovery.intro: Choose what you want to find out, from preparing a material hunt to checking crafting profit or exploring with your party.

craft.title: Crafting profit
craft.description: Compare material costs, production costs, and selling prices for equipment. Use the results to help decide what to craft.

search.use: Start with an item or orb

encyclopedia.title: Monster encyclopedia

find.title: Looking for materials or orbs?
find.body: Use monster search to check drops and locations. If you already have a destination, use map search to explore the monsters found there.

compare.title: Deciding what to craft?
compare.body: Select equipment in the crafting tool and compare costs with selling prices. Check current in-game prices before crafting, as the market changes.

check.title: Checking the details?
check.body: Updates and individual conditions can affect the information shown. Read the update history and confirm details against the game itself.

usage.title: Usage Notes
usage.text: The information on this site is organized to be as clear and easy to read as possible. However, actual in-game content may differ due to updates, specification changes, individual conditions, or simple errors in the posted information.

list.item1: The accuracy and completeness of the posted content are not guaranteed at all times.
list.item2: Please use this site at your own discretion and responsibility.
list.item3: The posted information may be revised, added to, or removed without prior notice.

usage.note: The site administrator shall not be held responsible for any disadvantage, damage, or trouble resulting from the use of information published on this site.

repost.title: Unauthorized Reproduction of Images and Text
repost.text: Please refrain from unauthorized reposting, redistribution, copying, mass screenshot reposting, or reuse on summary sites of any images, text, layouts, or uniquely organized data representations created by this site's administrator. If you wish to quote content, please notify the administrator.

copyright.title: Copyright
copyright.text: Dragon Quest X and all related names, in-game terms, images, settings, worldbuilding elements, and other associated rights belong to their respective rights holders. This site is an unofficial fan-made information site and does not claim any ownership of those rights.

unofficial.title: About This Unofficial Site
unofficial.text: This site is an unofficial website created to present Dragon Quest X information in a more accessible and easy-to-read format. It is not affiliated with the official operators.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.description: How advertising, analytics, cookies, tool data, and inquiries are handled.
PrivacyPage.intro: Learn what information the site handles, why it is used, who can see it, and how to manage your choices.

operator.title: Operator and scope
paragraphs: Astoltia Helper Tools (https://www.dqx-tool.com/) is an unofficial Dragon Quest X fan site operated by みきてぃ. This policy describes information handled through the tools, content reports, and inquiries.

contact.title: Information received through inquiries
paragraphs: Inquiries are directed to the operator’s X account. Account names, messages, and information needed to reply are used to review inquiries, respond, and address issues.
X’s privacy policy also applies to information handled on X. Do not include personal or confidential information, such as your real name, email address, or password, in public posts.

reports.title: Reports about incorrect information
paragraphs: The reporting feature stores your message, report target, supporting information such as the page URL, display language, and submission time on the server. A cookie identifies the submission source; hashed values of its identifier and your IP address are stored with the report. This information is used to review and correct content and manage submissions.

Report messages, status, and resolution notes may be displayed on the site when a report is made public. Do not include personal information in reports. The submitter identification cookie expires one year after it is set.

rooms.title: Shared Crystal Beast room information
paragraphs: Room names, participant names, assigned servers, exploration reports (server, map, gauge color, reporter name, and memo), and timestamps are stored on the server to share exploration progress.

People who know a room’s URL or code can view participant names and reports. Do not use rooms to store confidential information; use an in-game name when participating. Room information may be deleted, so rooms are not permanent storage.

storage.title: Cookies and browser storage
paragraphs: Local storage saves settings such as the display theme, crafting favorites and preferences, and Crystal Beast input preferences and tutorial status. These settings restore preferences and simplify repeat visits. Information submitted when joining a room or posting a report is also stored on the server, separately from browser settings.

Cookies are used to maintain login sessions, protect requests, and identify report submitters. You can delete or restrict cookies and site data in your browser, but this may reset preferences or affect some features.

ads.title: Google AdSense and advertising
paragraphs: This site includes the Google AdSense advertising tag. When ad serving is enabled, ads from third-party vendors, including Google, may appear. These vendors may use cookies to serve ads based on previous visits to this and other websites.

Google’s advertising cookies enable Google and its partners to show personalized ads based on visits to this and other websites. You can turn off personalized Google ads in My Ad Center. The third-party advertising choices page below also provides options for participating vendors.

analytics.title: Google Analytics
paragraphs: This site uses Google Analytics (GA4) through Google Tag Manager to understand page views and tool usage and improve content and usability. Google Analytics uses cookies and similar technologies to collect and process information such as pages viewed, interactions, and browser and device information.
See Google’s privacy policy and explanation of data use on partner sites for details. On supported browsers, Google’s opt-out browser add-on can disable Google Analytics data collection.

sharing.title: External services and visibility
paragraphs: Advertising and analytics send information from your browser to providers such as Google. Inquiries sent through X are handled on X. Each service handles information according to its own policies.
Please also note the public and shared visibility of content reports and Crystal Beast rooms described above.

retention.title: Storage and deletion
paragraphs: You can remove locally saved preferences using your browser’s site data controls. Clearing browser data does not automatically remove reports or room information already sent to the server.

To request access, correction, or deletion of submitted information, contact the operator with details identifying the information, such as the page and submission time. Information held by Google or X is managed under those services’ settings and policies.

choices.title: Privacy inquiries
paragraphs: Contact the operator’s X account with questions or requests to access, correct, or delete information. To avoid disclosing another person’s information or deleting the wrong content, we may ask you to clarify the target information and your connection to it.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This policy will be updated when features or services change. Refer to this page and its update date for the current version.
